rows.grounds: compound adjective describing one who has ascended a golden conveyance
expresses the state of delight or enjoyment
names the divine companions, the group of Vasus

items.question: What vehicle and companions accompany one who rejoices among the Vasus?
premises: One is mounted upon a golden vehicle.
One rejoices in that mounted state.
The rejoicing occurs together with the Vasus.
items.inference: Mounted on a golden vehicle, one rejoices in the company of the Vasus.
uncertainties: The subject is implied from the preceding verses describing the one who attains these realms.
items.plain_english: Mounted on a golden vehicle, he rejoices together with the Vasus.
